status: Review findings addressed in concept; no implementation or runtime validation claimed

organization_review.resolution: Added mandatory release manifest and prerequisite closure including metric/source tests, lifecycle, research/market, five-Project view and policy controls.
LB-19.06 is explicitly staging/prelaunch; LB-20.04 owns authorized deployment and subsequent production readback.
Threat-model completion requires selected mitigations and linked owners/tests; implemented security controls are required at LB-18.05 and release.
Every package has contextual fully qualified source URLs; bare cross-repository issue numbers are qualified before rendering.
PR target-branch activity, unique default-branch integration and stacked research lineage are explicit requirements and fixtures.
Minimal repository creation and issue publication are separate from new LB-02.07 runtime scaffolding; unresolved hosting/release decisions may remain Backlog.
Each package has priority/gate/role/references; every metric has a validated primary package mapping and source/definition fields.
Native issue types/fields, Project item fields/status and Project progress posts have explicit separate capability tests and tasks.
Authenticated evidence submission LB-10.02 now consumes canonical authentication LB-17.02.

final_consistency_review.finding: Optional exports were indirectly required by base hardening

org_acceptance_fixtures.name: Complete scope includes unboarded work
org_acceptance_fixtures.evidence: 329 issues + 62 PRs exist; Projects contain 325 issues + 6 PRs. The four issues outside Projects are .github#2 and website#31/#32/#33.
org_acceptance_fixtures.expected: Repository collection includes every allowed issue/PR. Project grouping neither excludes unboarded work nor counts board member PRs a second time.

org_acceptance_fixtures.name: Native relationship mirrors and correction churn
org_acceptance_fixtures.evidence: REST timelines contain 491 blocked_by_added plus 491 blocking_added, 64 removals of each mirrored form, and 310 parent_issue_added plus 310 sub_issue_added. Current native graph has 427 blockers and 310 parent-child edges.
org_acceptance_fixtures.expected: Mirrored endpoint observations produce one relationship operation. Removing a wrong dependency and adding its correction does not inflate unrelated delivery recognition. The reconciled current graph matches the captured native graph.

org_acceptance_fixtures.name: Stacked research PR integration
org_acceptance_fixtures.evidence: Eleven research PRs merged to research/market-intelligence rather than main; 107 merged-PR commit entries contain 92 distinct SHAs. Fifteen SHAs occur in more than one merged PR.
org_acceptance_fixtures.expected: PR-event participation and unique integrated-change metrics have distinct units. Repeated commits and child/parent diff overlap do not count twice as unique code delivered. Main integration is not assigned the earlier proposal-branch merge time.

org_acceptance_fixtures.name: Imported contracts and generated content
org_acceptance_fixtures.evidence: Raw PR additions total 134525; a diagnostic path heuristic finds 32222 contract additions and 9361 lock/generated additions. Research #44 imports the v1 contract, while website #2 vendors it again. These are diagnostic raw figures, not final eligible authored LOC.
org_acceptance_fixtures.expected: Raw volume remains inspectable. Imported/generated/lock content receives its declared classification; importing the same contract into the website does not certify original authored code. Research artifacts remain available in their own contribution categories.

org_acceptance_fixtures.name: Cross-API automation identity
org_acceptance_fixtures.evidence: 206 Project events have REST actor github-project-automation[bot] (Bot), while GraphQL reports github-project-automation and wasAutomated false.
org_acceptance_fixtures.expected: Stable account identity and verified type resolve one automation actor. A false wasAutomated flag does not route these actions to human achievement boards. Logins alone are not join keys.

org_acceptance_fixtures.name: Project schema differences and native issue types
org_acceptance_fixtures.evidence: Project 1 priority uses Critical/High/Medium/Low; Project 2 uses P0-P3 and Research Readiness; Project 3 status uses Todo/In Progress/Done; Projects 4/5 use Backlog plus Level, Phase, Workstream and Acceptance Gate. Timelines include 129 issue_type_added events.
org_acceptance_fixtures.expected: Mappings preserve source values by stable Project/field IDs. Native issue type changes remain distinct from Project Level/custom fields. Unknown historical fields do not acquire invented editors.

org_acceptance_fixtures.name: Partial research merge and reopened issues
org_acceptance_fixtures.evidence: Research #85 approval explicitly records partial research, pending handoffs, and reversal of automatic closures on issues #30-#32; those issues are currently open. Website #11 is an intentional failed-CI demonstration closed without merge.
org_acceptance_fixtures.expected: A merge creates the appropriate PR contribution but does not manufacture accepted research completion. A closed-unmerged PR never becomes a delivery. A reopened issue preserves valid earlier contributions while correcting its outcome state.

org_acceptance_fixtures.name: Review participation includes non-approval owner decisions
org_acceptance_fixtures.evidence: The audit observed 28 formal review records: 13 changes requested, 8 approvals, 6 commented and 1 dismissed. COMMENTED reviews include substantive adopted owner dispositions in the linked PRs.
org_acceptance_fixtures.expected: Review participation and accepted policy outcomes can recognize evidence-backed COMMENTED reviews. Neither approvals alone nor raw review text length defines quality; the same reviewer/PR retains distinct-review deduplication.

org_acceptance_fixtures.name: Contributor discovery without assigning unearned delivery
org_acceptance_fixtures.evidence: The audit observed external authors of multiple research PRs absent from the default-branch contributors endpoint, public offers to help, and accounts only assigned or mentioned. Those observations support different contribution states.
org_acceptance_fixtures.expected: Eligible external PR authors appear without requiring default-branch commits or organization membership. An offer can appear as participation with its actual state; assignment/mention/subscription do not confer completed-work credit or negative reputation.

org_acceptance_fixtures.name: Unavailable channels and limited tenure
org_acceptance_fixtures.evidence: All three repositories have Discussions disabled and no GitHub Releases. All 258 mobile planning items are Backlog and unassigned. Repositories were created on 2026-10-16; the snapshot is 2026-10-17 UTC.
org_acceptance_fixtures.expected: Unavailable discussion adapters are labeled unavailable; no recorded releases differs from unsupported channels. Mobile planning gets planning credit only. Historical trends/newcomer/active-week claims disclose the observation window and do not fabricate earlier history.
